After making some submissions, counsel for the Petitioner, states that he would like to withdraw the present petition with liberty to avail the statutory remedies under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, in respect of the alleged non-payment of compensation for the land acquired pursuant to Notification No. SG-DL-E-10012025-260117 dated 8th May, 2025.
